narrative.overview: Sitness should feel like something on your side: soft, rounded and warm in tone, never a drill sergeant. The dark theme is the home theme: a near-black page tinted a tenth of the way toward the chosen accent, with grey cards that carry a trace of it too. One accent does all the talking. The ring and the timer lead on Home; everything else recedes.
keyCharacteristics: One accent at a time (violet, teal, amber or coral), tinting page, greys and text.
A single 16px corner radius; circles only where the shape is a circle.
Large tabular numerals for time and score.
Screens sit side by side (Stats, Home, Settings) and slide in from their side.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Exactly one accent is on screen. It marks progress, the primary action and what is selected; it is never decoration.

rules.name: The Tint Rule
rules.body: Every dark grey carries 5-10% of the accent. Never use a neutral grey that ignores it.

rules.name: The Dark-First Rule
rules.body: Colour changes apply to the dark theme only unless the owner says otherwise.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every changing number uses tabular figures so it does not jitter.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay flat at rest and in motion; new depth comes from a tonal step, never a drop shadow.

dos: Do use var(--accent) for progress, the primary action and selection, and nothing else.
Do keep every radius at 16px, unless the shape is a circle.
Do tint any new grey with the accent, using the formulas in web/src/theme.ts.
Do keep touch targets at least 44px.
Do write messages in plain, kind words.
donts: Don't add drop shadows or gradients.
Don't add a bottom navigation bar; screens sit left and right of Home.
Don't change the light theme's colours as a side effect of a dark-theme change.
Don't shame or nag; the game layer rewards movement and never punishes.
